title.en: One window only: The self-built line is longer than Electric 15. Which page next
title.zh: 只留一个窗口：自建管路长过电动15，下一页是哪一台

description.en: Keep this cell as published. Do not stretch Electric 15. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai stops that rural row at 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal. Read it in the Xingtai table. On a grid, the next published building row with a single distance pair is Electric 20 at 120 m / 40 m, 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h and 1–2 cm stone. Taken from the printed row: Without a grid, the 4100 prints 40–100 m / 15–45 m, and Diesel 30 prints 60 m / 180 m at 15 m³/h. Keep this cell as published. Pick the page whose cells you can actually meet, including stone.
description.zh: 先不要把电动15拉长。邢台河北品锦机械把那一行农村泵停在垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。有电网时，下一档只印一对距离的建筑行是电动20：120 m / 40 m、22 kW、8–10 m³/h、石子 1–2 cm。没有电网时，4100 印 40–100 m / 15–45 m，柴油30印 60 m / 180 m、15 m³/h。选你真正对得上的那一页，包括石子。

heading.en: Convert from % Vacuum to Unit of Pressure

body.en: Borrow “Convert from % Vacuum to Unit of Pressure” from “Vacuum - Pressure Units Converter” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. Leave 60–80 m horizontal and 15–20 m vertical. Leave aside stretch Electric 15. Read it in the Xingtai table. Without a grid, the 4100 prints 40–100 m / 15–45 m, and Diesel 30 prints 60 m / 180 m at 15 m³/h. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. A 3 cm stone that was allowed on Electric 15 is outside Electric 20. Keep this cell as published. Diesel 30’s 60 m / 180 m or the 4100’s 40–100 m may already cover the line. Taken from the printed row: Send the metres that exceeded 60–80 m or 15–20 m, plus the stone. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai matches a listed page. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/vacuum-converter-d_460.html
body.zh: 把《Vacuum - Pressure Units Converter》的“单位压力”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。这一格照已印出的读：离开水平 60–80 m 和垂直 15–20 m。有电网、120 m / 40 m、石子 1–2 cm 的建筑管路是电动20。无电网且农村窗口更长时，按格子看 4100 或柴油30。目录里已经写着：柴油30的 60 m / 180 m 或 4100 的 40–100 m 可能已经盖住管路。柴油120的垂直 500 m 是 100 m³/h、8000 kg 的基建机器。管路只比电动15长出几米的住宅，不是那台机器。按邢台表上的原文理解：没有。已公布的格子就是窗口。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/vacuum-converter-d_460.html

heading.en: Example - Pressure in kPa and % Vacuum

body.en: The reference page “Vacuum - Pressure Units Converter” uses “Example - Pressure in kPa and % Vacuum” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. A grid building line at 120 m / 40 m and 1–2 cm stone is Electric 20. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai stops that rural row at 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal. Taken from the printed row: Pick the page whose cells you can actually meet, including stone. Read it in the Xingtai table. In that case the longer grid row may be Electric 30, which prints ≤ 3 cm and a short aggregate-13 distance of 20 m / 60 m beside a fine-stone 60 m / 180 m. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Diesel 120’s 500 m vertical is a 100 m³/h, 8000 kg infrastructure machine. Keep this cell as published. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Taken from the printed row: No. Read it in the Xingtai table. Its horizontal cell is 25 m, which is shorter. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The page does not invent a bridge model between Electric 15 and Electric 20.
body.zh: 来源页《Vacuum - Pressure Units Converter》用“例子压力”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。旁边那一台不在这句话里。不要把电动15拉长。邢台河北品锦机械把那一行农村泵停在垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。有电网时，下一档只印一对距离的建筑行是电动20：120 m / 40 m、22 kW、8–10 m³/h、石子 1–2 cm。没有电网时，4100 印 40–100 m / 15–45 m，柴油30印 60 m / 180 m、15 m³/h。选你真正对得上的那一页，包括石子。这一格照已印出的读：请发送超出 60–80 m 或 15–20 m 的那些米数，并附上石子。目录里已经写着：不是。它的水平格是 25 m，更短。

body.en: “Vacuum Ranges” is an outline label from “Vacuum - Pressure Units Converter”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Read it in the Xingtai table. No grid and a longer rural window is the 4100 or Diesel 30, depending on the cells. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. On a grid, the next published building row with a single distance pair is Electric 20 at 120 m / 40 m, 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h and 1–2 cm stone. Keep this cell as published. It also changes aggregate from 1–3 cm to 1–2 cm, adds 10 MPa, an 80 mm pipe, a 0.25 m³ hopper and 900 kg. Taken from the printed row: Read the stone before celebrating the longer vertical. Read it in the Xingtai table. A house that missed Electric 15 by a few metres of pipe is not that machine. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Keep this cell as published. The published cells are the window. Taken from the printed row: You send the measurements. Headings already printed: Electric 20 changes more than the metres Off-grid longer does not mean Diesel 120
body.zh: “范围”是《Vacuum - Pressure Units Converter》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。按邢台表上的原文理解：它还把骨料从 1–3 cm 改成 1–2 cm，并加上 10 MPa、80 mm 管、0.25 m³ 料斗和 900 kg。电动15允许的 3 cm 石子不在电动20里。这时更长的电网行可能是电动30，它印了 ≤ 3 cm，以及细石 60 m / 180 m 旁边较短的 13 骨料 20 m / 60 m。在为更长的垂直高兴之前，先读石子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。这一格照已印出的读：你发送测量值。邢台河北品锦机械对照已列页面。这一页不会在电动15和电动20之间编一台过渡型号。已印出的标题：电动20改变的不只是米数 无电网更长不等于柴油120
